title: UBlade3 core constants (exact, source-cited)
purpose: Machine-readable constants and formulas for the first playable exact C# port of HyperBlade 1996. Every value cites the decompilation source line or the original DATA file it was read from. Values from DATA are read from a locally owned, read-only retail install; they are not committed here.

sources.referencePort: third_party/hyperblade-20XX (modernised reference; any deviation is labelled referenceOnly)
sources.data: DATA folder of an owned retail HyperBlade install (D:/Games/HyperBlade/HYB/data during extraction); files are named by basename only here
sources.planDump: DATA/PLANS/*.PBN read with third_party/hyperblade-decomp/tools/plan_dump.py; plan bytecode is original game data

world.source: DATA/HOUDRO.ENV: arena collision ellipsoid is 105 x 187.5 x 105 data units (engine/arenaellipsoidstatic.cpp:13-15 with common/staticinitglobals.cpp:38); Dromer spawn positions are 40 75 0 (DATA/LOSAN.HTM:4). No metric conversion of world space exists in the decompilation.
world.note: Do not convert to metres or centimetres. The only centimetre arithmetic in the decompilation is the renderer projection (see projection.*).

velocity.value: DATA speed parameters are data units per second; the physics bodies carry per-frame displacement
velocity.source: physics/physicsbody.cpp:131 (flForwardSpeedDt = flDelta * m_flSpeed); physics/physicsbody.cpp:180 and 196 (same delta multiply on reset/retick); planvm/cglideonsurface.cpp:368 (per-frame target = flForwardSpeedDt * rating factor * g_flMaxSpeed)
velocity.note: PhysicsBody::flSpeed, flSpeedDt, flAccelDt, vel and step are per-frame quantities. The decompilation converts back to per second by multiplying by flInvDelta, for example physics/collisioncheck.cpp:353 and planvm/cglideonsurface.cpp:271. DATA SetMotionParams speed=48 (LOSAN.HTM:4) therefore means 48 units per second, which is 48/18 = 2.667 units per frame at the 18 Hz reference.

acceleration.value: DATA acceleration parameters are data units per second squared; per-frame implementations use delta squared
acceleration.source: physics/physicsbody.cpp:132 (flAccelDt = flDeltaSquared * m_flAccel); globals.cpp:225 and 795 (g_flGravityGameEngine = g_flGravity = 32.0f); physics/physicsbody.cpp:194 (flGravDeltaVel = flDeltaSquared * flGravAccel)
acceleration.note: Because a body carries per-frame displacement, a per-frame velocity change of accel * delta squared is the same physical acceleration as accel units per second squared at the current rate.

time.value: milliseconds for clocks and timeouts; seconds for engine delta
time.source: engine/engineclock.h:37-43; engine/gameengine.cpp:609-623 (timeGetTime deltas scaled by MS_TO_SEC = 0.001f); engine/gameengine.cpp:574

angle.value: degrees in DATA and object parameters, radians in physics
angle.source: physics/physicsbody.cpp:108 and 138-145 (DEGREES_TO_RADIANS 0.0174532925, azimuth -270 stored in DATA/LOSAN.HTM:4 becomes 90); globals.cpp:533 (g_flDegreesPerTurn = 360.0f); globals.cpp:537 (camera deg-to-rad 0.0174532923847436905)

steps: nPrevTickMs = nTickMs; nTickMs = timeGetTime(); g_flFrameDelta = (float)nTickMs - nPrevTickMs
tickFormula.result: flDelta is the mean of the last five frame deltas in seconds; flInvDelta is its reciprocal (the smoothed frame rate). At the 18 Hz reference flDelta = 1/18 s.

steps: Game::RunFrame records the frame start, calls Renderer::BeginScene, then g_pGameEngine->PerFrameUpdate(), then EndScene, scene draw, HUD draw, Renderer::PresentFrame
PerFrameUpdate clears ENGINEOBJECT_POSED on every object, then switches on m_wRunState

ENGINE_RUN_PLAYING: TickClock(); m_flGravityDt = 32.0f * flDeltaSquared; for each object PhysicsBody::PerFrameTick(); Postpass() when a network session is active; BroadcastCollisionEvents(); ProcessInputCommandQueue(); ClearPendingEvents(); session pump/sync
ENGINE_RUN_PAUSED: only the main camera's ViewIt() runs
ENGINE_RUN_RESTART: RestartMatch() then TogglePause(hWnd, 1) and return

physicsBodyTick.then: target Process(0) for LOCAL/BUILDING phases, ProcessReceivedPacket plus target Release(0) for NETWORK, PlanState PostUpdateCleanup, and ObjectStats::UpdateMomentumAndEnergy for KIND_DROMER

modernReferenceDeviation.note: This is the 20XX modernisation, not the 1996 behaviour. For the exact clone implement TickClock as above; the 20XX fixed tick is useful only as a parity harness choice if the Lead decides to hold the clock fixed.

cameraTrackingEllipsoid.note: 2.2 units inside the arena so camera tracking stays inside the wall (trackingellipsoidstatics.cpp:1)

ellipsoidFormulas.inside: flSum = invZZ*z*z + invYY*y*y + invXX*x*x; inside when flSum <= 1.0 (PointInside, 0x00408ea0, lines 16-25)
ellipsoidFormulas.height: GetZ(x,y): remainder = (1 - x*invXX*x) - y*invYY*y; if remainder < 0 return 1; else return -sqrt(remainder) * radiusZ (0x0042f0d0, lines 346-356)
ellipsoidFormulas.normal: NormalAtPoint picks the axis whose band the point is outside (z band checked first, then x, then y); returns null only at the centre; epsilon 0.0001; result is not re-entrant and lives in m_vNormal (0x0042f120, lines 362-443)
ellipsoidFormulas.radialBoundaryXY: flRadius = sqrt(flSquare / (flSquare*invXX + invYY*y*y)) with flSquare = x*x, or 1e-5 when |x| <= 1e-5; sign follows x <= 0; y = (y/x)*flRadius, z unchanged (0x0042f040, lines 307-341)
ellipsoidFormulas.radiusForDirection: horizontal = (|x| + |z|) / 2; absY = |y|; total = absY + horizontal; if total < 1e-8 return 0; return (horizontal*radiusX + absY*radiusY) / (3*total) (0x0042f350, lines 450-462)
ellipsoidFormulas.rayIntersection: solved in double, parameterised by the first direction component outside +/-0.0001; quadratic root flRoot = halfB*halfB - ((invZZ*armB*armB + invYY*armA*armA) - 1) / quad; near/far roots; Vec3::FindClosest orders them (0x0042eb00, lines 97-299)

markerSurfaceYMinus.note: the original passes +6.0f to GetZ here too (game.cpp:270 comment)

constants.note: full field of view is 85 degrees; halfFov = degToRad * 85.0f / 2.0f
m_flBungeeLength at construction; CTrack pulls with (distance - length) * 1.5 (engine/ctrack.cpp:211)
renderer-only; do not use as world scale
engine/ctrack.cpp:215 doubles the pull when it is already negative

trackingFormulas.countdownOnTargetChange: flFrames = invDelta * 0.75f, floored at 10, when a previous target exists; otherwise invDelta * 1.5f (engine/ctrack.cpp:131-143)
trackingFormulas.trackVector: vTrack = target - cameraPos; vTrack.z += cameraTrackingHeight; vLook = target - cameraPos; vLook.z += cameraLookHeight (engine/ctrack.cpp:201-209)
trackingFormulas.pull: flPull = (|vTrack| - bungeeLength) * 1.5f; if flPull <= 0 then flPull *= 2.0f; desiredVel = normalize(vTrack) * flPull (engine/ctrack.cpp:211-220)
trackingFormulas.flyBranch: states BEH_FLY, BEH_RAIL_SLIDE or countdown: vel += (desiredVel - vel*0.6f); clamp |vel| <= flStep; pos += vel; clamp inside g_camTrackEllipsoid by IntersectSegment + FindClosest (engine/ctrack.cpp:240-279)
trackingFormulas.chaseBranch: vWish = target - facing*bungeeLength; clamp inside g_camTrackEllipsoid; vPull = vWish - camPos; smart camera adds vPull*30 then clamps; normal chase: vel += (desiredVel - vel*0.6f) + vPull*30; clamp |vel| <= flStep; pos += vel (engine/ctrack.cpp:280-358)
trackingFormulas.outOfViewCorrection: if |offset from wish line| > 2.0f and not out of view: camPos += half the gap, vel += 0.25f * (chasePos - camPos) (engine/ctrack.cpp:360-444)
trackingFormulas.finalPosition: vSum = pos + dir*settings.y + side*settings.x + up*settings.z; scaled = surfNormal * cameraMinHeight; ray-clamp vSum on the cam ellipsoid; vFinal = normalize(target - (scaled + vSum)) * bungeeLength; pos = target - vFinal (engine/ctrack.cpp:446-499)
trackingFormulas.lookDirection: m_pDir = vLook; with a secondary tracked object: normalize(normalize(secondaryPos - pos) + vTrack); with countdown: swing six steps, angle from acos of the horizontal directions (engine/ctrack.cpp:501-632)
trackingFormulas.smoothing: posOut += (bodyPos - aPosRing[i]) * posWeight; dirOut += (bodyVelDir - aDirRing[i]) * dirWeight; ring[i] = current; indices advance modulo counts (engine/cameraobject.cpp:191-216)

viewItFormulas.basis: dirOut = m_aPosRing[nIndex] based shake vector; right = shake x dirOut normalised; up = right x dirOut normalised; the right/basis rows are transposed into m_pRotB
viewItFormulas.eye: vPos = posOut + cross(settings.x) + dir(settings.y) + normal(settings.z) where cross = dir x trackedSurfNormal (engine/cameraobject.cpp:319-335)
viewItFormulas.cull: frustum cull uses the composed view matrix; clip.w is matrix row 3 when m_bHasRow3 is set, otherwise 1.0 (engine/cameraobject.cpp:366-373)

default.source: app/config.cpp:89 (Vec3 g_vViewSteepness = { 0, 0, g_flTwoSteering }), g_flTwoSteering = 2.0f at common/staticinitglobals.cpp:40

trackOffsets.source: globals.cpp:352-358 (g_apTrackOffsets); storage declared engine/game.cpp:42-47; reader app/config.cpp:169-175; consumer planvm/planactiontracking.cpp:198,229,262,346 and planvm/plancond.cpp:1148-1150

The reader order (app/config.cpp:159-175) leaves the four track-offset triples unread because the shipped @v02 record carries two floats past the five the format takes, so the floats after it do not line up; all offsets keep their zero initialisers (engine/game.cpp:42-46).

keyboardFallbackEffectiveValues.source: same reader order with the 38-row DATA/DFTKEYBD.CFG; the @v02 record leaves 1.2 and 2.0 before its colon, so birdsEye reads x=1.2, y=2.0 then fails and the other offsets stay zero

configDefaults.note: all start at g_flOneSteering = 1.0f (globals.cpp:829) before DATA/DFTSTICK.CFG or DATA/DFTKEYBD.CFG is read

shippedEffective.source: DATA/PREFS.TXT -> Data/DftStick.cfg, read by app/config.cpp:136-186; file begins with 40 integer rows (flags, key, index), then four floats, then the @v02 record

movementAxesFormulas.shootDrive: HELD_SHOOT holds axis.x += flPush; release keeps driving for 1000 ms past the release
movementAxesFormulas.turn: flTurn = g_flNetTracking * flSpeed * 0.072f; left/right set axis.y to +/-flTurn (times 4.0f while stop is held) and clamp to flSpeed * 0.2f after the pull term
movementAxesFormulas.forwardCentring: with HELD_FORWARD the code rotates the axis toward the latched direction: flDot = 1 - dot(velDirLatched, velDir); flCross = latched.y*dir.x - latched.x*dir.y; the sign of flCross moves axis.y by |flDot|*flPush
movementAxesFormulas.cap: if |axis.x| >= flCap, axis.x = sign(axis.x) * flCap; otherwise unchanged
movementAxesFormulas.decay: when no relevant input, |axis| > 0.005 decays by 0.15 per frame; below that it is zeroed

steeringForceFormula.lateral: vLateral = surfNormal x velDir (components: n.z*d.y - n.y*d.z, d.z*n.x - n.z*d.x, n.y*d.x - d.y*n.x), normalised
steeringForceFormula.normal: if flSteerScale > 1.000001: smoothVel += (vLateral*axis.y + velDir) * flSteerScale; else smoothVel += vLateral*axis.y + velDir*axis.x

speedAndDrag.frictionAtOrAboveOne: velDir = local transform column 1 (m_a[0..2][1]); vel = velDir * 0.01 (Vec3::ScaleTo(m_pVelDir, 0.01f, m_pVel); velDir unchanged); smoothVel and bankForce cleared; if already on the surface return
speedAndDrag.terrainStep: target = vel + prevPos; shell.RayIntersection(&surfNormal, &target, &pos); vDiff = pos - prevPos; vStep = vDiff + smoothVel + bankForce; flSpeed = |vStep|; if invDelta * speed > 0.001 velDir = vStep / speed, otherwise keep the previous direction
speedAndDrag.bank: vBank computed from surfNormal * flGravDeltaVel; flDouble = flDelta * flGravDeltaVel * normal.z * (friction * 2.0f) * 12.0f
speedAndDrag.targetSpeed: flTarget = flForwardSpeedDt * (weightedSpeed * 0.05f + 0.65f) * carrierScale * alt * g_flMaxSpeed, where carrierScale = 0.9f when this player carries the rok else 1.0f, and alt = 1.0f when pos.z > 0 else flSteerScale
speedAndDrag.drag: if speed <= flTarget: if flDouble <= speed, vNext = vOut - velDir*flDouble; when dot(vNext, vel) < 0 and the owner is a goalie with no input, post MSG_GLIDE_TO_STOP and set vOut = 0
speedAndDrag.step: vel = vOut; then body.step = vel * invDelta, the per-second form of the per-frame velocity (planvm/cglideonsurface.cpp:449-452)
speedAndDrag.verticalProjection: normal = arenaEllipsoid.NormalAtPoint(worldPos); velDir -= normal * dot(normal, velDir); normalise (planvm/cglideonsurface.cpp:414-441)

bodyIntegrationFormulas.integrateMotion: move.dir = target - pos; normalize; if |target-pos| > 50 snap pos = target; flStep = flDeltaSquared * g_flBandwidth; flAccelDt = flStep; flStep *= distance; ringSmooth[nRingIndex] = flStep * move.dir; smoothVel = 0.25f * sum(ringSmooth[0..3]); flForwardSpeedDt = |body.step| * flDelta * 1.232f; vel += smoothVel; InitOnSurface(0); ringHistory[nRingIndex] = vel when speed > 0.001; velDir = normalized sum of ringHistory[0..3]; nRingIndex = (nRingIndex+1) % 4 (0x004082c0, lines 615-695)
bodyIntegrationFormulas.initOnSurface: prevPos = pos; next = pos + vel; shell.RayIntersection(&surfNormal, &next, &pos); surfNormal = shell.NormalAtPoint(pos); flSpeed = |vel|; if flSpeed > 0.001 velDir = vel / flSpeed; velDirLatched = velDir; smoothVel = bankForce = 0 (0x00408190, lines 568-611)
bodyIntegrationFormulas.updateVelocityDirection: drag = 1 - friction; blend = drag - shell.friction; weight = shell.elasticity * body.elasticity; dot = vel . surfNormal; proj = -dot * surfNormal; vel = (vel + proj) * blend + proj * weight; flSpeed = |vel|; if > 0.001 velDir = vel / flSpeed (0x00408760, lines 795-834)
bodyIntegrationFormulas.stepWithGravity: prevPos = pos; pos += flFrac * vel; pos.z -= flFrac * (0.5f * flGravDeltaVel); vel.z -= flFrac * flGravDeltaVel; flSpeed = |vel|; velDir = vel / flSpeed when speed > 0.001 (0x004086a0, lines 766-791)
bodyIntegrationFormulas.integrateGravity: prevPos = pos; pos += vel; pos.z -= 0.5f * flGravDeltaVel; if flGravDeltaVel < 0.01f: flGravAccel = 32; flGravDeltaVel = flDeltaSquared * 32; vel.z -= flGravDeltaVel; flSpeed = |vel| (0x004085d0, lines 730-761)
bodyIntegrationFormulas.resetOnSurface: ResetDynamics; pos.z = prevPos.z = shell.GetZ(pos.x,pos.y); surfNormal = shell.NormalAtPoint(pos); velDir latched and projected into the plane, normalized; vel = flSpeed * velDir; smoothVel = axis = 0; flFacing = 0 (0x00407ab0, lines 275-329)
bodyIntegrationFormulas.setFlatOnTerrain: target.z = shell.GetZ; place object; normal basis into local transform; rotation Z by flFacing; ApplyRenderSlotPose (0x00408a60, lines 941-1023)
bodyIntegrationFormulas.updateBanking: HELD_ROTATE rotates velDir by +/- g_flBankingAngleRad (0.1f rad) around Z and repositions the main camera at camera bone 9 minus bungee along the body's local Y (0x00408940, lines 873-937)

objectStatsFormulas.weightedStat: GetWeightedStat(index) = (energy * g_flStatWeightScale + 0.25f) * m_aStats[index + 1], with g_flStatWeightScale = 0.0075f (common/staticinitglobals.cpp:13) and energy = m_aStats[0] (0x00474930, lines 48-55)
objectStatsFormulas.defaults: InitDefaults: every stat 5.0f, stat[0] = 100.0f, SPEED = 7.0f, DAMAGE = 100.0f; m_flScale = m_flSpeedRatio = g_flBaseStatsSentinel = 1.0f (0x004748e0, lines 26-45; globals.cpp:270)
objectStatsFormulas.speedRatio: flMomentum = (((stamina - 4.0f) * 0.15f + 0.5f) * flDelta + 1.0f) * m_flSpeedRatio; capped at 1.0f (0x00474bb0, lines 185-195)
objectStatsFormulas.energy: energy regenerates by (g_flSpeedRateBase + 0.5f - stamina*0.15f) * flDelta, capped 100; g_flSpeedRateBase = 2.0f (globals.cpp:271); draining below 30 and above 100 toggles g_bEnergyDraining (0x00474bb0, lines 185-245)

speedBurst.start: if speedRatio > 0.3 the scale is 1.0f else 0.0f; m_flTarget = (80.0f / period) * scale + 1.0f; flSteerScale = 1.05f; axis.x += 0.25f; flFriction = 0.1f
speedBurst.process: while flSteerScale > 1.0f: speedRatio *= 1 - flDelta * (1.5f when carrying else 1.0f), floored at 0.05f; if target > boost then boost += flDelta; else on the floored frame boost *= (1 - flDelta * 0.8f) and when it reaches 1.0f the item detaches

dataMotionParams.source: DATA/HOUDRO.ENV, DefineObject type=Rok name=AndRoll modfile=Rokmix (same keys in every ENV); parser engine/gameengine.cpp:1757-1875 (Cmd_SetMotionParams, 0x00482b00)

objectConstants.value: abs(value) 0 or 1 -> bone 0; 2 -> bone 7; 4 -> bone 8; killState != -1 -> bone 2; at spawn slot -> bone 0

flight.bindClamp: if 80.0f * flDelta < vel.z then vel.z = 80.0f / flDelta (g_flFrameRateReference = 80.0f, globals.cpp:292; planvm/cprojectandbounce.cpp:35-38)
flight.gravity: IntegrateGravity each frame: pos += vel; pos.z -= 0.5f * flGravDeltaVel; vel.z -= flGravDeltaVel with flGravDeltaVel = flDeltaSquared * 32 (physics/physicsbody.cpp:730-761)
flight.ellipsoidClamp: when pos.z < 0 and the point is outside g_arenaEllipsoid, IntersectSegment(prevPos,pos) gives near/far, FindClosest picks the boundary point, the body is pushed to it plus 1.0f in z, UpdateVelocityDirection bounces, and StepWithGravity(1 - fraction) advances the remainder (planvm/cprojectandbounce.cpp:115-199)
flight.sideBoundary: when pos.z >= 0 and invXX*x*x + invYY*y*y > 1.0f, ComputeRadialBoundaryXY clamps x/y, normal at boundary, UpdateVelocityDirection, velocity.z is restored (planvm/cprojectandbounce.cpp:200-231)
flight.speedCap: flCap = 2.0f * flForwardSpeedDt; if |vel| > flCap, |vel| = flCap and vel = velDir * speed (planvm/cprojectandbounce.cpp:239-248)
flight.springVariant: CProjectAndBounce::IntegrateSpringAndGravity pulls toward m_vStep with flDeltaSquared and applies GRAVITY_SCALE = 16.0f * flDeltaSquared on z; this is a different integrator from the flight path and must not be mixed with it (planvm/cprojectandbounce.cpp:279-338)
flight.collisionResponse: UpdateVelocityDirection: drag = 1 - friction; blend = drag - shellFriction; weight = shellElasticity * bodyElasticity; vel = (vel - dot*normal)*blend + (-dot*normal)*weight (physics/physicsbody.cpp:795-834)

launchFormulas.throw: speed = ((shotPower * 0.04f + 0.8f) * 110.0f) * flDelta; velDir = carrier velDir with z += 0.5f then normalised (0x00403a30, lines 419-454)
launchFormulas.launchAt: leads the target by the rok's flight time to the goal, with scatter dice DICE_WIDE = 7, DICE_NARROW = 6, JITTER_SPAN = 21, JITTER_BIAS = 10 (0x00403d70, lines 491-497)
launchFormulas.kickDown: DAMP_RATE = 10.0f; if vel.z > 0 halve it; vel.z -= flDelta*10; clamp vel.z at 0; vel.x *= -0.25; vel.y *= -0.25 (0x00403cf0, lines 459-487)

storage.increment: IncrementHomeScore/IncrementAwayScore add one; Reset sets both to -1 and then immediately calls InfoBar::IncrementScore(5) and (4), which increments both to 0 (engine/gameengine.cpp:4902-4910; ui/infobar.cpp:1304-1325)

goalValueMapping.rule: the goal clamps the rok's signed value: SGoal clamps up to at least 1, NGoal clamps down to at most -1 and flips the sign; then value 1 -> arm 0, value 2 -> arm 1, value 4 -> arm 2; any other value -> arm 0; if the rok is attached the code writes 4 and then overwrites it in every path (dead arm 4); if the rok is at its spawn slot the result is 3
goalValueMapping.evidence: DATA/PLANS/NGOAL.PBN and SGOAL.PBN via tools/plan_dump.py: arm [0] sends MSG_NGoalScored to slot 23 once, arm [1] twice, arm [2] four times, arm [3] four times; DATA/PLANS/INSCRTBL.PBN (the GOD/scoreboard plan) calls id_ACF_IncrementScore once per received MSG_NGoalScored/MSG_SGoalScored. Arm [3] also calls id_ACF_IncRokValue(8) four times, ending the rok value at -4.

steps: the goal plan receives its own goal-scored message and arms the post-score behaviour
RokScoreValue decides the scoring arm; each arm emits one to four MSG_GoalScored broadcasts and the matching MSG_NGoalScored/SGoalScored messages to SLOT_GOD (23)
the GOD plan (INSCRTBL.PBN) calls id_ACF_IncrementScore(0) for home or (1) for away once per message, then rebroadcasts the goal message to slots 0 to 3
InfoBar::IncrementScore turns the line into the numeric score text and dirty flags

rokValue.down: nMode -= 2; the first step past 0 plays MSG_DOUBLE_SCORE with 1; clamped at -4
rokValue.special: if the stored value is exactly 1 it is normalised to 0 before the request is applied (planvm/plancond.cpp:3863-3866)
rokValue.displayFmt: x%d of abs(value), positive and negative labels on different rows (ui/infobar.cpp:91-129 (InfoBar::UpdateRokValue); ui/hud.cpp:754-777)

gates.aiThreshold: PlanCond::GoThroughMuliplier: delta = rok value (sign-flipped for odd carrier slot); if delta >= 4 answer 1; else compare against the team's RATING_MULTIPLIER0 when winning or RATING_MULTIPLIER1 when losing, clamp the threshold to 4 with 2 as the default when the rating is outside ±4, and if the coach condition flag is set force 4 (planvm/plancond.cpp:7745-7818)

teamsHtm.format: text; DefineTeam one line, then DefineObject type=Dromer blocks with SetMotionParams, SetPlans, SetRatings1/2/3 and optional SetGoalieRatings* blocks
teamsHtm.ratingsKeys: id_RAT_ names; the loader table is engine/gameengine.cpp:2442-2542 (Cmd_SetRatings, 0x00483b50)
teamsHtm.motionExample: DATA/LOSAN.HTM:4 pos = 40 75 0 accel=30 speed= 48 azim= -270 elev = 45 fric=.01 elas=0.32

dromesEnv.format: text; DefineObject blocks of type Drome/Rok/NGoal/SGoal/Ramp/Multiplier/Turnstile/LimboPole/LaserHurdle/Armory/Mine/Swarf/Hurdle/Randomizer, each with SetMotionParams, SetPlans and SetCollisionObject lines
dromesEnv.example: DATA/HOUDRO.ENV:2 DefineObject type=Drome ...; :6 DefineObject type=Rok ...; :9 SetPlans rok; :11 SetCollisionObject type=RokBubble radius=1 ...

booieIni.source: DATA/BOOIE.INI; names read by engine/gameoptions.cpp; defaults verified at engine/gameoptions.cpp:100-139 and further read getters

keyConfigs.source: DATA/DFTKEYBD.CFG, DATA/DFTSTICK.CFG, DATA/DFTMOUSE.CFG; parsing order app/config.cpp:136-186
keyConfigs.layout: 40 rows of (int flags, int key, int index), then four floats: forceIncrement, maxAcceleration, maxSpeed, forceRelaxation, then @v02 <victimCam int> <5 floats: bandwidth, netTracking, stopForceFactor, speedBurstFactor, viewSteepness.z> :, then four triples of floats intended as birdseye, firstPerson, overShoulder, overShoulderRok track offsets
keyConfigs.shippedPrefs: DATA/PREFS.TXT contains Data\DftStick.cfg (forward slashes in JSON here; the file uses a backslash)

plans.format: DATA/PLANS/*.PBN, ADLIB compiled p-code; DATA/PLANS.CAT lists the plan files; read with third_party/hyperblade-decomp/tools/plan_dump.py

nonConstants.tickReferenceNote: There is no single fixed tick rate in the original. The 18 Hz value is the initial and nominal reference; the game actually advances by the smoothed measured frame time. Any C# implementation that claims exactness must reproduce TickClock or explicitly pin a tick and record the deviation.
nonConstants.unitWarning: Only the renderer projection uses centimetres (72 dpi, 2.54 cm per inch). Do not use those numbers to scale world positions, velocities or the arena.
